I've created a new file `list_assets.py` that's focused solely on listing all Samsara assets and their last data timestamps. Key features:

1. Uses pagination to fetch ALL assets (not just the first page)
2. Shows key asset info:
   - Name
   - ID
   - Type
   - VIN (if available)
   - Last data timestamp
   - Hours since last data

Usage:
```bash
# Using environment variable
export SAMSARA_API_TOKEN='your_token'
python list_assets.py

# Or using command line arg
python list_assets.py -t your_token

# Save to CSV
python list_assets.py -o assets.csv
```

The script will display the assets sorted by hours since last data (most stale first) and optionally save to CSV.

I've made several important changes to fix the API integration:

1. Updated the endpoint to use the v1 API: `https://api.samsara.com/v1/fleet/assets`

   - Location time is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

3. Added better error handling for timestamp conversion
4. Simplified pagination since v1 API handles it differently
